title: MRL quality–storage trade-off
description: KO 100-query union-pool MAP@10 is 0.9430 at 768 dimensions and 0.9381 at 256 dimensions. For one million fp16 vectors, storage decreases from 1536 MB to 512 MB, or one third. Vector storage excludes index overhead; encoder output remains 768-dimensional. Local MAP@10 axis 0.930–0.950. No uncertainty interval supplied.
generator_python:

from html import escape
x0,x1,y0,y1=190,1040,150,485
sx=lambda x:x0+x/1800*(x1-x0)
sy=lambda y:y1-(y-.93)/.02*(y1-y0)
a=['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="620" viewBox="0 0 1200 620" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">', '<title id="title">'+escape(s['title'])+'</title>', '<desc id="desc">'+escape(s['description'])+'</desc>', '<rect width="1200" height="620" fill="#FFFFFF"/>', '<g font-family="Arial, sans-serif" fill="#11120F" font-weight="400">']

 a.append(f'<text x="{x:.2f}" y="{y:.2f}" font-size="{size}" class="{cls}" text-anchor="{anchor}" fill="{fill}" font-weight="{weight}">{escape(t)}</text>')
text(90,64,s['title'],24,'figure-title',weight=700)
text(190,119,'Union-pool MAP@10 · KO 100 queries',22,'panel-title')
a.append(f'<line x1="{x0}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x1}" y2="{y1}" stroke="#B8BBB5" stroke-width="1.5" class="axis-x" data-axis-id="score"/>')
a.append(f'<line x1="{x0}" y1="{y0}" x2="{x0}" y2="{y1}" stroke="#B8BBB5" stroke-width="1.5" class="axis-y" data-axis-id="score"/>')
for v in [.93,.935,.94,.945,.95]:
 y=sy(v);text(174,y+7,f'{v:.3f}',20,'axis-tick','end','#686B66')
for v in [0,512,1024,1536]:
 x=sx(v);text(x,520,f'{v:,}',20,'axis-tick','middle','#686B66')
text(615,563,'fp16 vector storage for 1M items (MB)',22,'series-label','middle')
for pt in s['points']:
 x,y=sx(pt['storage_mb']),sy(pt['map_at_10']);c='#5E7FD8' if pt['dimension']==256 else '#686B66'
 a.append(f'<circle cx="{x:.2f}" cy="{y:.2f}" r="8" fill="{c}" class="data-mark"/>')
 text(x,y-22,str(pt['dimension'])+'d · '+format(pt['map_at_10'],'.4f'),22,'value-label','middle',c)

Path('assets/images/posts/noisy-click-mrl-retrieval/hero.svg').write_text('\n'.join(a)+'\n')
